About Jumpstart Academy

Building foundations for multiple opportunities.

Jumpstart Academy is an online learning platform built around one simple idea: many competitive examinations share a substantial common General Studies foundation.

We bring common GS subjects together so students can build knowledge once and use that foundation across compatible examinations.

Our focus is clarity, connection, consistency and confidence — not simply finishing a syllabus.
